name: Gaussian precise integration method
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用于基础结构动力响应求解的精细时间积分方法。
usage_overview: 用于基础结构动力响应的时间积分求解，将矩阵指数形式的时间推进与外载项的高斯积分相结合，计算基础结构随时间变化的响应。

complete_examples.text: Leveraging the low-frequency nature of infrastructure vibration, this study introduces Gaussian precise integration method, com bined with multi-step hybrid solution, enables accurate resolution of infrastructure vibration with arbitrary integration step.
To improving the computational efficiency of the dynamic equations, this study introduces Gaussian precise integration method based on the so lution method proposed in Ref. [55].
